responsibility: Declares the public Tree SSA address-manipulation interface centered on the mem_address decomposition of memory references. This header exposes helpers to describe, validate, fold, and rebuild MEM_REF/TARGET_MEM_REF trees, to lower affine addresses into target-valid address forms, to copy reference metadata, and to query preferred scaling factors for indexed memory accesses, making it the interface used by loop IV and address optimization passes rather than a pass definition itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface header for the tree-SSA address utilities: it defines struct mem_address and declares the address-lowering, validation, folding, and metadata-copy helpers. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-address.cc, it does not implement target address decomposition or RTL-based legality/cost logic.
